Terminal rendering for normal-terminal writes.

This deliberately uses direct terminal operations, not a fullscreen diff. Scrollback content is appended once as ordinary terminal output; only the volatile fat-prompt region is cleared and repainted around those appends.

Imports

minline

Vars

terminalLock: Lock

Consts

SyncBegin = "\e[?2026h"
SyncEnd = "\e[?2026l"

Enter the single terminal-writer critical section. Reentrant so editor redraw callbacks can hold the frame while minline performs nested writes.
